id: # Clues (TROPY) and conclusions (WNIOSKI) in the notebook. The note is what
# Szary writes down, in his words
pl_name: he does not always write the whole truth.

en_note: LAMP FINE. FUSE TAKEN OUT BY HAND.
LOCK FINE. A KEY OR A FRIEND.
BOGDAN'S CAP ON THE STAIRS.
22:00 K., WITH TEA. (KUBA?)
BOGDAN'S BIKE AT THE LIGHTHOUSE DOOR.

pl_note: TRAWA POD WIATR OD LATARNI DO MORZA.
en_note: GRASS AGAINST THE WIND, LIGHTHOUSE TO SEA.

pl_note: CAŁY WIECZÓR NA PLAŻY. TAK MÓWI.
en_note: ON THE BEACH ALL EVENING. SHE SAYS.

pl_note: WIE, ŻE ROWER STOI POD DRZWIAMI.
en_note: KNOWS THE BIKE IS AT THE DOOR.
BOGDAN NEVER RIDES ON SAND.
DRAGGED UP THE DUNE. RECENTLY.
MISSING. TECHNICIAN AT DAWN.
AT THE LIGHTHOUSE FOR DRIFTWOOD.
KUBA LEFT 22:00, BACK AFTER MIDNIGHT.
KUBA OWES RYSIEK A LOT.

pl_note: KŁÓTNIA Z WUJKIEM O KASĘ. ŚWIECIŁA.
en_note: ROW WITH HIS UNCLE OVER MONEY. LIGHT ON.
KUBA HAS A KEY TO THE LIGHTHOUSE.
BORROWS THE BIKE. NOT TONIGHT.
KUBA'S BOOTS WET WITH SEA WATER.
IN THE BAR FROM 23:00. HE SAYS.
THE MEWA, 2003. THE KOWALEWSKIS.
A BOAT AT SEA WITH NO LIGHTS.
KUBA: A WOMAN BRINGS HIM TEA.

pl_note: ŁÓDŹ RYŚKA. KUBA PRZY ŁODZI OD 23:00.
en_note: RYSIEK'S BOAT. KUBA THERE FROM 23:00.

pl_note: DZIŚ ROCZNICA MEWY. HALINA BYŁA U BOGDANA.
en_note: MEWA ANNIVERSARY. HALINA SAW BOGDAN.
NORDBALT. PASSES WYDMA AT 05:40.
ASKED ABOUT THE AURORA YESTERDAY.
AN OLD TALE OF BEACH ROBBERS.

pl_note: DWIE MILE OD WYDMY. TOR TUŻ OBOK.
en_note: TWO MILES OFF WYDMA. FAIRWAY CLOSE BY.
THE MEWA SANK. THE AURORA WAS NEAR.
AN ACCIDENT. SIGNATURE ILLEGIBLE.

pl_note: AURORA: TA SAMA NAZWA, TEN SAM KAPITAN.
en_note: AURORA: SAME NAME, SAME CAPTAIN.
CROWBAR AND BLANKET FROM THE BOOT.
A NEW PADLOCK ON THE BUNKER.
THE FIRE, NOT THE LIGHT. AURORA.
SHE DIDN'T WANT TO HURT ME.
I HAVE IT. THE LIGHT CAN BURN.
NOT IMPORTANT.
SOMEONE ELSE RODE BOGDAN'S BIKE.

pl_note: Z PLAŻY NIE WIDAĆ DRZWI. SKĄD HALINA WIE O ROWERZE?
en_note: YOU CAN'T SEE THE DOOR FROM THE BEACH. HOW DOES HALINA KNOW?

pl_note: BOGDAN WYSZEDŁ BEZ CZAPKI. SAM ALBO ZA KIMŚ.
en_note: BOGDAN LEFT WITHOUT HIS CAP. ALONE, OR WITH SOMEONE.

pl_note: RYSIEK I KUBA PODAJĄ INNE GODZINY.
en_note: RYSIEK AND KUBA GIVE DIFFERENT TIMES.

pl_note: MOKRE BUTY I ŁÓDŹ BEZ ŚWIATEŁ.
en_note: WET BOOTS AND A BOAT WITH NO LIGHTS.
WAS HALINA WITH BOGDAN AT 22:00?
HALINA IS WAITING FOR THE AURORA. WHY?

pl_note: MEWA ZATONĘŁA PRZY AURORZE. MĄŻ I SYN HALINY.
en_note: THE MEWA SANK BY THE AURORA. HALINA'S HUSBAND AND SON.

pl_note: OGIEŃ NA WYDMIE UDAJE LATARNIĘ. AURORA SKRĘCI NA MIELIZNĘ.
en_note: THE FIRE ON THE DUNE POSES AS THE LIGHTHOUSE. THE AURORA WILL TURN FOR THE SANDBANK.
